title: chrysanthemum makinoi
intro: Chrysanthemum makinoi, commonly known as Makino's chrysanthemum or Japanese chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throat, and digestive issues, due to its rich content of bioactive compounds that offer numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum makinoi include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating respiratory infections, skin conditions, and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum makinoi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
